sourceReceipts.title: Professional language after a previously raised risk occurs
sourceReceipts.notes: Ali supplied the source. The complete public carousel was inspected directly on 2026-09-04: twelve examples plus a bonus turn an internal 'I told you so' reaction into calmer workplace language about a prior risk, recommendation, assumption, mitigation, trade-off or documented decision. The creator's captions and exact lines are inspiration only; they are not factual authority and must not be copied into LAiDIES public prose.

opportunities.title: Move from 'I told you so' to the next accountable decision
opportunities.readerValue: Readers get language for the moment a risk they raised actually occurs: preserve the record, state the changed fact, reopen the mitigation and request a named decision without making vindication the point.
opportunities.facts: The source is a social carousel containing twelve examples and a bonus. It presents alternative workplace phrasing for referring back to earlier risks, recommendations, assumptions, mitigation plans, trade-offs and documented decisions after events prove the concern relevant.
opportunities.attributedInterpretation: Leigh-Anne Harrison frames the leadership move as raising the risk, documenting the concern, influencing the decision and responding professionally when the outcome later supplies the evidence.
opportunities.laidiesInference: The durable LAiDIES job is decision recovery, not politeness coaching: name the prior record without relitigating intent, state what is true now, identify the immediate consequence, reopen the prepared option or mitigation and ask the accountable owner for the next decision. The pattern should preserve power and bias context and include an escalation boundary where ordinary phrasing is not enough.

destinations.name: career-work-life
destinations.proposedJob: Build an original situation-to-line tool for the Career/Work-Life desk: prior record, changed fact, mitigation or option, and decision request. Keep the public label Career/Work-Life unless Ali separately restores Corner Office.

destinations.name: workplace-try-on
destinations.proposedJob: Let the reader practise the pattern across an ordinary project miss, a repeated ignored warning and a case that should move to a formal workplace process rather than a polished comeback.

destinations.name: episode-3-receipts-pass
destinations.proposedJob: Connect the language pattern to the existing distinction between discussed, proposed, decided, assigned and open only if the current Episode 3 source remains admitted.

destinations.name: internal-practice
destinations.proposedJob: Use the same record-change-decision structure in LAiDIES incident and release discussions when a documented risk materializes.

practiceCurrency.recheckTrigger: Current workplace research and a role-distinct language review establish when the pattern helps, when power or bias changes the move and when a formal escalation route is required.

opportunities.notUsedReason: The social source establishes a useful format, not evidence that the phrasing is safe or effective across workplaces. Original exact prose, women-specific power and bias context, a formal-escalation boundary and independent review are still required before a public card or practice.
